description: Defines the QbonePacketProcessor class and related enums and interfaces for processing IPv6 packets in the QBONE network, including packet filtering, forwarding, and ICMP handling.

classes.name: QbonePacketProcessor
classes.description: Handles IPv6 packet processing, filtering, and ICMP messaging within the QBONE network.

classes.name: QbonePacketProcessor::OutputInterface
classes.description: Interface for sending packets to client or network.

classes.name: QbonePacketProcessor::StatsInterface
classes.description: Interface for tracking packet processing statistics.

classes.name: QbonePacketProcessor::Filter
classes.description: Interface for custom packet filtering logic.

methods.name: QbonePacketProcessor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the packet processor with IP addresses, subnet length, output, and stats interfaces.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes an IPv6 packet, deciding to forward, respond, or drop.

methods.name: set_client_ip_subnet_length
methods.description: Updates the client IP subnet length.

methods.name: ProcessIPv6HeaderAndFilter
methods.description: Processes IPv6 header and applies filtering logic.

methods.name: SendIcmpResponse
methods.description: Sends an ICMP response to a destination address.

methods.name: SendTcpReset
methods.description: Sends a TCP RST packet in response to a TCP packet.

methods.name: ProcessIPv6Header
methods.description: Performs sanity checks and TTL decrement on IPv6 header.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response packet based on processing outcome.

methods.name: GetDestinationFromPacket
methods.description: Extracts destination address from a packet.
